name: Hotel Excelsior Dubrovnik
insider_take: Perched dramatically on cliffs overlooking the azure Adriatic, this legendary grande dame has been Dubrovnik's most prestigious address since 1913, hosting royalty, Hollywood stars, and dignitaries against the backdrop of the UNESCO World Heritage Old Town.
whats_special: The hotel sits just 150 meters from Dubrovnik's iconic Pile Gate entrance to the medieval Old Town, offering unparalleled views of Lokrum Island and the ancient city walls. Its clifftop location provides exclusive access to a private beach and the famous Villa Orsula, once a 14th-century summer residence of Dubrovnik nobility.
pro_tip: Book a sea-facing room on the upper floors for breathtaking sunrise views over the Adriatic, and time your arrival for the evening "blue hour" when the Old Town's limestone walls glow golden against the darkening sea.
dont_miss: The hotel's terrace restaurant offers front-row seats to Dubrovnik's famous sunset views, while the nearby Banje Beach (5-minute walk) is perfect for swimming with postcard views of the city walls. Take the hotel's private boat transfer to explore hidden sea caves and secluded beaches along the Elafiti Islands.
pros: Prime clifftop location with stunning Adriatic Sea views
Walking distance to Dubrovnik's UNESCO Old Town
Elegant rooms with traditional Croatian hospitality
cons: Historic building with traditional architecture may have smaller room layouts
